text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
where consecutive victories are on the 
line. Symboli Kris S remains as calm and 
composed as ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having found her own way of being, she 
stood strong and commanded the crowd's 
excitement as she headed into the race.
